newsitem.title: JAPAN: Some Japan finance shares weak despite stocks gain.
newsitem.headline: Some Japan finance shares weak despite stocks gain.

text.p: Some Japanese financial sector shares remained vulnerable on Wednesday, even though most issues which had been hit hard recently rose in line with the strong rebound in the Nikkei 225 average, brokers said.
Shares in Tokuyo City Bank ended down 16 yen at 118 yen, making it the biggest percentage loser on the first section of the Tokyo Stock Exchange. Volume was 2.619 million shares.
The benchmark Nikkei index of 225 leading shares closed up 655.72 points, of 3.78 percent, at 18013.88.
Nippon Credit Bank Ltd rose just two yen to end at 247 yen, while Daiwa Bank Ltd ended up three yen at 515 yen.
Brokers said that lingering worries about the ability of Japanese banks to write off problem loans dragged down some banking shares.
Unless these shares started to head upwards, the Nikkei 225's rebound would remain fragile, they said.
